steps.content:
You, heaven on earth! What kind of curse

Once cast an ominous shadow over you?

A thousand years of oppression

Stained your brilliance with blood and pain

Until your wonderful stars washed the stains away with their tears.

steps.speaker: Construction Worker
steps.content: Hey, Miss Poet, get down from the rooftop. We need to get working now!

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: I'm coming... I'm coming. I was reciting the poem to boost your spirits before you got started on the day's work.

steps.speaker: Construction Worker
steps.content: You can say whatever you want. Just as long as you don't show up at our construction site every day.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: That wouldn't do. The sight of you working under the night sky is so inspiring, and your burning soul is so dazzling!

Scenes like this have quickly become a daily occurrence. Whether it's due to the habits she acquired while working as a reporter or her genuine concern about the progress of the construction work, no one can say for sure.
Every now and then, Raven can be seen having a "friendly conversation" with the construction team sent by the Bureau.
Fortunately, the members of the construction team are worldly enough to not be greatly affected emotionally while dealing with a Sinner.
Of course, although she occasionally fools around, Raven is never idle.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Why are you here this late? There isn't enough work in the Bureau to keep you busy?
Before you can say anything, Raven thrusts a thick file folder into your arms.
You open the folder and take out the papers. A quick glance tells you that it's written in that overly flamboyant style of hers.
The Syndicate Academy, where the children in Syndicate find hopes and dreams!
Say no to war, say yes to peace! Reject ignorance, embrace knowledge!
With the full support of the MBCC Chief! What are you waiting for? Enroll now!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What is this?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Isn't it obvious? It's a recruitment brochure.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: The school is in Syndicate. So it's written in a style befitting Syndicate!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Why did you decide to write this thing all of a sudden?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Yesterday, while inspecting the school, I stumbled upon this classroom. It's basically finished; I put some desks and chairs in the room to see how it looked.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: You know what, the classroom is quite big, big enough to hold at least fifty desks and chairs, almost as big as those classrooms I saw during my schooldays in Eastside.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Then I thought to myself, "Since I've got the desks and chairs, why not get the podium and blackboard in as well?"

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: See? We've got everything here except for the students.
Raven points to the empty desks and chairs in the classroom, then waves the thick stack of recruitment brochures in her hand.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Just wait and see.
The next day...
A few curious kids are often seen milling around outside the Syndicate Academy.
They watch from a distance at first, and Raven pretends not to notice them.

Slowly, as if in a game of Statues, they sneak closer and closer, so as to take a better look at the building. More than once, while Raven is examining the content of the textbooks, she finds the kids looking in from behind one of the windows.
And then, Raven turns her head toward the window suddenly. Caught by surprise, they duck out of sight as one.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: It's fine. Kids don't have much patience. Just wait, and they will come to us. Now, show me the textbooks.
You open the trunk, take out the textbooks, and hand them to Raven.
Raven flips through them one by one.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Hate to admit it, but these are quite well-written. They won't need much tweaking, except for this one...
Raven extracts the history textbook from the stack and places it on the table.

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: Miss Raye.
The sudden voice interrupts Raven, and the kids, with their minds made up, have come out of hiding.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Oh my, how nice of you to greet me. I rarely hear people call my real name these days; it feels strange, to be honest.

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: We, um...

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Want to attend school here?

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: Not exactly. We just want to learn poetry writing from you. Your poems inspired us a lot in the past.
Raven is rendered speechless for a moment, a rare thing to witness, but she quickly regains her composure.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Hahaha... Of course you can come and learn how to write emotive poems from the great poet of DisCity, as long as you attend school here.

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: Can I, um, only take classes in poetry? Because I heard your other classes... are a bit...

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: A bit what? And who said that?
Raven raises her eyebrows, and the children exchange glances of amusement.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Won't tell, huh? Well, let me take a guess then... Remarks of this nature can only come from...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I said it.
A shadow slithers out from the base of one of the walls and takes on human form.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Well, if it isn't the naughty dropout who made a habit of skipping school! Now you think you're good enough to criticize your old teacher?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I read the textbooks you left behind from cover to cover several times. Some of the content is just too difficult for kids of their age; not the right teaching materials.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Oh, you a fan of my writings?
Raven gives a teasing smile.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: You rotten bird!

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: By the time I started teaching the kids from the Homeless, it had been a good decade since I graduated from middle school. Could you blame me if I didn't get the difficulty level right for all the materials?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: This time is different, though.
Raven points at you; you're unloading textbooks from the Bureau's vehicle.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: With the help of the MBCC Chief, we can't go wrong with the textbooks this time!

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Disian, mathematics, history, social studies, science... Anything that can be taught will be taught here.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: I can help you transform yourselves into a new generation of Syndicans who will carry the torch of hope for Syndicate.
Raven's earnestness seems a bit too much for the leader of the Homeless.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Well, I'll take your word for it this time. These books are from Eastside, right?
Crache's eyes scan the room and land on the glossy cover of the history textbook on the table. They linger for a few seconds before looking away.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: <size=25>Do history textbooks from Eastside record the troubled history of Syndicate?</size>
A bell rings out. You check your watch. It's 2 p.m. on the dot.

steps.speaker: Construction Worker
steps.content: Sorry, did we disturb you? We were installing a school bell; it went off by accident.
You make a gesture that says it's not a problem. And then Crache leaves you and walks toward the other end of the school campus.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: It's almost time, Ica. It's time for the combat skills class.

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: Ah... Okay, boss.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: And your classes... I'll look forward to them a bit, just a bit.
Crache walks away and waves goodbye without a backward glance.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Safe journey. Remember to come when school starts. I'll be waiting for you here.
Raven waves at the receding backs of the homeless kids until they disappear around the corner.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: What a sharp-witted kid... I'll have to give her extra homework.
Raven sighs. She opens the textbook in front of her.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: In N.F. 84, the BR-000 appeared following a large explosion in DisSea, and left an impact so profound that it's difficult to eliminate its effects even today.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Syndicate was originally called the West District. According to the West District Order Management Regulations, the region was left to the local violent gangs for self-government.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Thanks to the Hypercube discovered by Dr. Keylan, DisCity was established. Also thanks to the Hypercube, DisCity grew into a megacity, the only one on the continent, attracting countless immigrants and ushering in a prosperous era.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: These are some snippets from the textbook. What do you think?

options: I think it's suitable for children.

choices.text: I think it's suitable for children.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Syndicate doesn't feature much in it, don't you think?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: They obscure Syndicate. Whenever Syndicate comes up, it's referred to as DisCity. Worse still, in some cases, they stigmatize it.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: This is not the kind of history that we should teach the children in Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Where there is light, there must be shadow. You can't have one without the other... I will not let the efforts of generations of Syndicans go down the drain.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Their sacrifices, their achievements, deserve to be remembered.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: To instill hope and faith in children, hope for a better future, faith in the light ahead... This is my aspiration.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Or it was, up until that incident...
Raven seems lost now; she's always been confident and determined.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Join me, Chief of the MBCC. I need your help and advice.
Raven extends her hand to you.
